Apply a Piecewise Linear Table

Source: R/prox_spec.R
prox_apply.Rd

Evaluates the map penalty_prox_spec describes, in R, which is what a compiled loop does and what the tests compare the table against.

Usage

prox_apply(spec, u)

Arguments

spec

A table, as penalty_prox_spec returns it.

u

The points, one per coefficient.

Value

A numeric vector as long as u.

See also

penalty_prox_spec

Examples

pen <- lasso_penalty(n_coef = 2L)
sp <- penalty_prox_spec(pen, list(lambda = 1.5), step = c(0.5, 2))
prox_apply(sp, c(2, 2))
#> [1] 1.25 0.00
